# UsageOutcome

How a run ended, or that it had not ended when its usage was recorded.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"InProgress"` | The run had not ended when the usage was recorded. |
| `"Finished"` | The run finished. |
| `"Error"` | The run failed or timed out. |
| `"Killed"` | The run was stopped. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.

## Where it's used

- Inside [`UsageOutcomeTotals`](usage-outcome-totals.md)
- Inside [`UsageRunRow`](usage-run-row.md)
